summary: Sandbach United welcome Alsager Town in a local derby looking to bounce back from a penalty shootout defeat to the same opponents in the Macron Cup. Manager has recalled Nathan Barry and Robbie Hatton to the starting lineup alongside Matty Birchall and Jacob Vernon at left back following last week's cup exit. The Bach will be hoping prolific striker Joe Bevan, who sits sixth in the league's all-time goalscorer charts with 135 goals, can help them climb the table against a side currently near the bottom.
